profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I graduated from Simpson College with a Bachelor of Arts in Computer Science and a minor in Mathematics. I am a talented software engineer with strong roots in standards-adherance and driving process improvement to make teams I work with more efficient.

I am an expert learner, meaning I can pick up new technologies and become proficient with them in a very short period of time. I always ask a high volume of questions and heavily utilize the resources I surround myself with to efficiently understand the root of a problem and identify the solution.
